This week we hosted Noemi Licata Tiso, the head of the international office from the partner institution, the Quasar Institute for Advanced Design in Rome, with whom we have excellent cooperation in the field of Erasmus+ study exchanges. First and foremost, the purpose of the visit was to improve inter-institutional cooperation, share best practices and promote the internationalization of higher education institutions. network.stated_total_quote: The Faculty of Design actively participates in the Erasmus+ programme since the academic year 2007/2008. Currently our network involves over 70 signed Erasmus bilateral agreements and a very broad student and staff mobility.
network.coverage_note: The evidence provides a list of specific Erasmus+ partners mentioned in news articles, but a comprehensive list of all 70+ bilateral agreements is not provided.
